function shuffle(a){return [...a].sort(()=>Math.random()-.5)}
function renderSentences(){const host=document.getElementById('sentenceTasks');host.innerHTML='';sentenceData.forEach((d,idx)=>{const task=document.createElement('div');task.className='task';task.innerHTML=`<img src="${d.img}" alt="Подсказка"><div><b>${idx+1}.</b><div class="chips bankchips"></div><div class="answer-row" data-idx="${idx}"></div><div class="rowtools"><button class="smallbtn">↩ Очистить строку</button></div><div class="feedback"></div></div>`;host.appendChild(task);const bank=task.querySelector('.bankchips'),ans=task.querySelector('.answer-row');shuffle(d.parts).forEach((p,j)=>bank.appendChild(makeSentenceChip(p,`${idx}-${j}`)));task.querySelector('.smallbtn').onclick=()=>{[...ans.children].forEach(c=>bank.appendChild(c));task.querySelector('.feedback').textContent=''};ans.ondragover=e=>e.preventDefault();ans.ondrop=e=>{e.preventDefault();const id=e.dataTransfer.getData('text/plain');const el=document.querySelector(`[data-chipid="${id}"]`);if(el)ans.appendChild(el)};});}
const sentencePinyin={
'每天':'měitiān','妈妈':'māma','上班':'shàngbān','走路':'zǒulù','爸爸':'bàba','开车':'kāichē','坐':'zuò','校车':'xiàochē','哥哥':'gēge','上学':'shàngxué','弟弟':'dìdi','早上':'zǎoshang','七点':'qī diǎn','起床':'qǐchuáng','姐姐':'jiějie','睡觉':'shuìjiào','晚上':'wǎnshang','十点':'shí diǎn'
};
function makeSentenceChip(txt,id){const c=document.createElement('button');c.className='chip';c.textContent=txt;c.dataset.py=sentencePinyin[txt]||'';c.draggable=true;c.dataset.chipid=id;c.onclick=()=>{const task=c.closest('.task');const ans=task.querySelector('.answer-row'),bank=task.querySelector('.bankchips');(c.parentElement===ans?bank:ans).appendChild(c)};c.ondragstart=e=>{c.classList.add('dragging');e.dataTransfer.setData('text/plain',id)};c.ondragend=()=>c.classList.remove('dragging');return c}
function checkSentences(){let correct=0;document.querySelectorAll('#sentenceTasks .task').forEach((task,i)=>{const got=[...task.querySelector('.answer-row').children].map(x=>x.textContent);const ok=JSON.stringify(got)===JSON.stringify(sentenceData[i].solution);const f=task.querySelector('.feedback');f.className='feedback '+(ok?'ok':'bad');f.textContent=ok?'✓ Верно':'✗ Проверьте порядок';if(ok)correct++});const all=correct===sentenceData.length;markComplete(1,all);showResult('res1',all,`Правильно: ${correct} / ${sentenceData.length}`)}
function resetSentences(){renderSentences();markComplete(1,false);showResult('res1',false,'Упражнение сброшено.')}
renderSentences();

const ws1={grid:[['每','今','明','月','学','开'],['昨','天','年','坐','校','车'],['起','床','早','上','晚','下'],['睡','觉','午','饭','班','去'],['商','工','秘','律','老','中'],['人','作','书','师','美','国']],targets:['每天','今天','明天','昨天','今年','明年','学校','开车','起床','早上','晚上','上班']};
const ws2={grid:[['我','他','她','独','生','子'],['你','们','火','电','校','日'],['公','共','汽','车','地','铁'],['睡','年','租','中','学','下'],['觉','明','今','昨','上','班'],['走','路','每','天','放','学']],targets:['我们','你们','他们','她们','独生子','火车','电车','公共汽车','地铁','睡觉','每天','放学']};
const pinyinTargets={
  1:{'每天':'měitiān','今天':'jīntiān','明天':'míngtiān','昨天':'zuótiān','今年':'jīnnián','明年':'míngnián','学校':'xuéxiào','开车':'kāichē','起床':'qǐchuáng','早上':'zǎoshang','晚上':'wǎnshang','上班':'shàngbān'},
  2:{'我们':'wǒmen','你们':'nǐmen','他们':'tāmen','她们':'tāmen','独生子':'dúshēngzǐ','火车':'huǒchē','电车':'diànchē','公共汽车':'gōnggòng qìchē','地铁':'dìtiě','睡觉':'shuìjiào','每天':'měitiān','放学':'fàngxué'}
};
const wsState={1:{start:null,found:new Set()},2:{start:null,found:new Set()}};
function lineCells(a,b){const dr=b.r-a.r,dc=b.c-a.c;if(!(dr===0||dc===0||Math.abs(dr)===Math.abs(dc)))return null;const steps=Math.max(Math.abs(dr),Math.abs(dc));const sr=steps?dr/steps:0,sc=steps?dc/steps:0;let out=[];for(let k=0;k<=steps;k++)out.push({r:a.r+sr*k,c:a.c+sc*k});return out}
function initSearch(n,data){const g=document.getElementById('grid'+n);g.innerHTML='';data.grid.forEach((row,r)=>row.forEach((ch,c)=>{const e=document.createElement('button');e.className='cell';e.type='button';e.textContent=ch;e.dataset.r=r;e.dataset.c=c;e.setAttribute('aria-label',`Иероглиф ${ch}`);e.onclick=()=>selectSearch(n,data,e);g.appendChild(e)}));const t=document.getElementById('targets'+n);t.innerHTML='';data.targets.forEach((w,idx)=>{const tag=document.createElement('span');tag.className='target';tag.dataset.word=w;tag.textContent=pinyinTargets[n][w]||w;if(n===2&&(w==='他们'||w==='她们')) tag.title=w;tag.setAttribute('aria-label',`Слово ${idx+1}: ${pinyinTargets[n][w]||w}`);t.appendChild(tag)})}
function selectSearch(n,data,e){const st=wsState[n];const pos={r:+e.dataset.r,c:+e.dataset.c};document.querySelectorAll('#grid'+n+' .cell.sel').forEach(x=>x.classList.remove('sel'));if(!st.start){st.start=pos;e.classList.add('sel');return}const cells=lineCells(st.start,pos);if(!cells){st.start=pos;e.classList.add('sel');return}const word=cells.map(p=>data.grid[p.r][p.c]).join('
